$comment: Known invalid responses per spec. See scripts/corpus.ts.

apple-app-store-connect.note: Mostly a spec bug: oneOf lists the same schema object twice (included[], errors[].source). Undiagnosed: GET /v1/appInfos/{id} included[].type enum mismatch.

codat-accounting.note: allOf: [{type: string}, {type: null}] for nullable fields (e.g. currency) is unsatisfiable

github.note: oneOf error bodies (409/422 on contents and blobs) whose branches have no required fields; any realistic object matches both

linode.note: Spec bugs: identical Credit Card / Google Pay oneOf branches; label pattern (?!..) only admits 2 characters but minLength is 3. Undiagnosed: backups automatic[].type enum mismatch.

nexmo-verify.note: oneOf error bodies whose branches are all-optional objects with the same fields

rebilly.note: Undiagnosed: kyc-documents oneOf over document types matches 0 or 2 branches; ready-to-pay feature oneOf.

shipengine.note: Spec bug: allOf members each set additionalProperties: false (links, advanced_options). Undiagnosed: url-format hrefs, address_residential_indicator enum, created_at pattern.

telnyx.note: detail_records oneOf branches have no required fields and rely on discriminator, which JSON Schema validation ignores

vercel.note: fields declared {type: "null", oneOf: [string, number]} (a broken 3.0 nullable conversion) are unsatisfiable

zuora.note: object definition allOf gives `origin` contradicting enums (system vs custom) across members
